description: Activate when: user says 'founder mindset' or 'founder mode'; asks 'default alive or default dead'; says 'do things that don't scale'; says 'am I avoiding the hard thing'; is deciding whether to hire/fire/pivot/raise/cut burn at an early-stage company; feels comfort-seeking creeping in; cannot tell if they are on the path to success or slow death. Do NOT activate when: user is running a mature well-understood business (manager frameworks apply); user is an employee within a startup with fixed scope; the decision is purely tactical (which CRM, which button color). More: deciqai.com/c/founder-mindset
